title: 易智魔方 MCP 对接配置
description: 填写开放平台个人 API Key 以连接易智魔方 MCP。凭证仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传云端。仅支持个人 Key（sk- 前缀），团队 Key 会被拒绝。
description_en: Enter your personal Open Platform API Key to connect EasyMofang MCP. Credentials are stored only on this device under ~/.workbuddy and are never uploaded. Personal keys (sk- prefix) only; team keys are rejected.
docLabel: 如何获取易智魔方 API Key？
docLabel_en: How to get an EasyMofang API Key?

fields.label: API Key
fields.placeholder: 在易智魔方开放平台创建，以 sk- 开头的个人 Key
fields.placeholder_en: Create in EasyMofang Open Platform; personal key starting with sk-
fields.description: 用于鉴权的个人 API Key。团队 Key 不支持。失效后请到开放平台重新生成并在此更新。
fields.description_en: Personal API Key for authentication. Team keys are not supported. If expired, regenerate it in the Open Platform and update here.
